I have used the same mascara for years and was getting tired of it clumping my lashes. I decided to try a new product. I absolutely love Lash Ease One Step! It’s super easy to apply and does not clump. The product lasts all day and is easy to remove.

Came on time. Beautiful packaging. Decent BUT it’s ordinary mascara. I have bought (and returned) several like this boasting thicker longer lashes and got very little noticeable difference. Had on no mascara for a meeting, I left the room (of mostly women) and applied as directed. Came back into the room and none of the women noticed at all. I even asked one friend and she got up close and said oh yeah .. did you go put on mascara? No rave reviews.

reviews.t: Very pleased, one layer does the trick!

reviews.t: Amazon's System of Reviews Are Very Helpful For Those of Us Contemplating a Purchase!
reviews.x: An ad for this mascara just came on TV.  It caught my eye because I have thin lashes and I am also always looking for a new mascara that just might do what the company says it might do. I do most, if not all, of my shopping on Amazon, and have found that every time I don't consider the majority of the reviews, I have regretted it, especially when the newer product cost double or more than the product that I am currently using. This mascara seems to fall under this description. I read all the rev

reviews.t: Makes your lashes really long when it works.
reviews.x: I’ve been using this brand of mascara for several months without a problem. I received this tube and on the 3rd time using it the stopper at the mouth of the tube that scrapes off some of the mascara fell into the tube. You can’t get it out. So now when you take the brush out of the tube there’s gobs of mascara on the brush. You have to wipe it off of the brush with a tissue or it can’t be applied.  Now I’m wiping it off the brush and throwing it out. What a waste!

I was looking forward to trying this mascara to boost my lashes. Unfortunately I was not sold on this product. I felt like it clumped my lashes together making it look like spider legs on my eyes. It doesn't separate the lashes to give them a fuller look. I didn't find it to make my lashes look fuller or longer. The eye on the right is with the mascara and the eye on the left is without product.

Well I've been giving this mascara the old college try. After a month or so, I can say,m with all confidence, it's a loser in my book. It takes on average, three or four coats to get the length i want. It sure is not like they show on TV. Maybelline Falsies works exactly the same at half the price. So I say to all, save your money and leave this out of your makeup routine.

I love this stuff . Usually mascara makes me look like a raccoon but this stuff dries and it’s great . Also , the length that I get from this is amazing . I paid 15 bucks at Walmart and then I realized I could it jere for 7 bucks . I’m hooked .

I built and built as instructed.  Very disappointed with the outcome.  Save your money and go with the over the counter.  You won't want to cry as you throw product in the garbage!!! Will not throw money at this companies product ever again!!!

reviews.t: Save your money! No long lashes here!
reviews.x: The lashease came quickly! I have thin and sparse lashes! But this product did  not give me long and thick lashes! I dont know why some reviews said they loved the product! Very dissapointed! Will return!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the mascara does not lengthen or thicken lashes as advertised, calling it no better than cheaper drugstore brands.
Several reviewers report the product clumps or fails to deliver noticeable results compared to ordinary mascara.
A number of reviewers praise the mascara for making lashes look longer and thicker.
Some reviewers highlight that it does not clump and is easy to apply, lasting all day.
A few reviewers mention the packaging looks high quality and the product is easy to remove.
